label: SEC EDGAR company search
terms_note: Free JSON APIs (submissions, company facts, full-text search) without a key; the SEC requires a declared User-Agent (company + contact e-mail) and ≤10 requests/s — anonymous fetch answered 'Request Rate Threshold Exceeded'. Public companies only.

config_fields.name: contact
config_fields.help: Company name and e-mail, required by SEC fair-access rules: 'Sample Company Name AdminContact@<sample company domain>.com' is appended to the User-Agent (https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_US_SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT.

adapter.rate_note: 'Our current maximum access rate is 10 requests per second' (https://www.sec.gov/os/webmaster-faq#developers); undeclared or excessive automated access is blocked (about ten minutes). 'Automated access must comply with SEC.gov's Privacy and Security Policy, as described in the Developer FAQs' (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-application-programming-interfaces).

get_company.note: `id` MUST be the 10-digit zero-padded CIK ('https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json, where ########## is the entity's 10-digit central index key (CIK), including leading zeros'), e.g. 0000320193 — the adapter does not pad it. `industry` is sicDescription (sic code under raw.sic); `address` is the business street line (city, stateOrCountry, zipCode under raw.addresses.business); tickers, exchanges, formerNames and the filings index stay under raw. `website` is often empty.

not_offered.me: EDGAR is anonymous — there are no credentials and no account endpoint; only the User-Agent contact is declared (https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data).
not_offered.search: The documented JSON APIs are keyed by the 10-digit CIK and none accepts a company-name query; no name-search endpoint is documented on https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-application-programming-interfaces (the static company_tickers.json list would need client-side filtering the adapter cannot express).

live_check.notes: needs operator config: SEC fair access requires a real company name + e-mail in the User-Agent (PLATFORM_MCP_US_SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT); without one data.sec.gov answers 403 from every egress, and live_verify never invents a contact; requires contact; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
